[[File:Infantry_Mine_CCG.jpg|thumb|250px|A mine on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]]]
'''Anti-personnel mines'''<ref name="RB">{{JournalCite|9|Repulsortank Battlefield}}</ref> or '''personnel mines''' were [[Mine/Legends|mines]] keyed to respond to individuals rather than vehicles. Although possession of them was illegal in some places in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], they could be purchased for around five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].
